title: QA_Platform_version_item_type_lowercase_2
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Nothing is versioned by this case.
steps: 1. POST /item_versions with item_uuid {{eventGroupUuid}} and item_type "eventgroup" (lower case).
2. Read the sandbox back: is_latest_version must still be true.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — ALLOWED_ITEM_TYPES is the exact list %w(EventGroup) and the check runs before any lookup (app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:3, 9-11). No item_versions row, no replica event.
rationale: The allow-list is case-sensitive; a lenient fix (downcase/classify) would also widen the constantize at line 13.

title: QA_Platform_version_item_type_as_array_2
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Nothing is versioned by this case.
steps: 1. POST /item_versions with item_type sent as the array ["EventGroup"].
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — an Array is not blank but ALLOWED_ITEM_TYPES.exclude?([..]) is true (app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:9-11). Must never reach `item_type.constantize` (line 13), which would raise on an Array.
rationale: Wrong JSON type on the one field that is fed to constantize.

title: QA_Platform_version_undecodable_item_uuid_2
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. WrongUuid1= decodes to nil in ParamsAuth#check_for_uuid.
steps: 1. POST /item_versions with item_uuid "WrongUuid1=" and item_type EventGroup.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — item_uuid is rewritten to item_id = nil (app/controllers/concerns/params_auth.rb:57-80), so item_id.blank? is true (app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:9-10).
rationale: A garbled id must be a parameter error, not an 'event not found' or a crash.

title: QA_Platform_version_nonexistent_event_888
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to id 999999999 (no such event group).
steps: 1. POST /item_versions with item_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== and item_type EventGroup.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 888 'Invalid Parameters' — EventGroup.find_by(id: 999999999) is nil and `item.blank?` answers 888 before the policy (app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:13-16). Note the code is the same one used for 'not live' and 'not latest', so the client cannot tell the three apart.
rationale: Well-formed id of a record that does not exist.

title: QA_Platform_version_raw_item_id_not_numeric_888
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. A raw item_id (not item_uuid) is NOT decoded by ParamsAuth — only keys containing 'uuid' are.
steps: 1. POST /item_versions with item_id "QA_Platform_abc_{{stamp}}" (text) and item_type EventGroup.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 888 'Invalid Parameters' — find_by(id: <text>) casts to no row (app/controllers/api/item_versions_controller.rb:13-15). Must not be a 500 from a type-cast error.
rationale: The controller accepts a raw item_id as well as item_uuid; a raw id bypasses uuid decoding entirely, so its type handling matters.

title: QA_Platform_live_line_item_quantity_edit_bypasses_amendment
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it changes the sandbox's line item.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with only line_items: the existing line item (by uuid) with quantity 7.
2. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items and GET /trade/{{tradeId}} and compare the quantities.
expectedResult: Should be refused (a published event's quantities change only through a new version with an amendment remark). Today: HTTP 200 — status is nil and line_items is present, so update_event_group_data takes the execute branch (app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:33-35) and create_line_items rewrites the meta/precomputed data of the line item in place (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:95-140). The trade product of the stage is NOT touched, so the event line item and the RFQ line vendors quote against now disagree; no remark, no event_revise_notification (that fires only for an amendment draft, event_group_controller_helper.rb:2632-2637).
rationale: The core amendment bypass: a buyer can change what is being bought on a live event with no version, no remark and no vendor notice.

title: QA_Platform_live_line_item_negative_quantity_stored
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it changes the sandbox's line item.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with the existing line item and quantity -5.
expectedResult: Should be 422. Today 200: get_details_for_event_group_line_items only flags 0/nil as rate-only and never rejects a negative value (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6303-6318) and EventGroupLineItem has no validations (app/models/event_group_line_item.rb), so -5 is stored on a live event.
rationale: Negative boundary on the live-edit path (the create path is covered by EDGE-CRT; this is the LIVE state).

title: QA_Platform_live_delete_only_line_item_711
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. The sandbox has exactly ONE active line item (the journey's create_draft makes one).
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items: [{uuid: the line item, status: "deleted"}].
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 711 'You cannot delete this line item from the project' — update_line_items refuses when the only active line item is deleted (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:171-176). The line item stays active.
rationale: Removing the last thing being bought from a live event must be refused (withdraw is the path for that).

title: QA_Platform_live_line_item_unknown_product_raises_500
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to a product id that does not exist.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with the existing line item but product_uuid Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==.
expectedResult: Must be a 422. get_details_for_event_group_line_items does product_by_id[...] then `product.id` with no nil check (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:6299-6300) → NoMethodError → 500, and the 8-second event lock taken by lock_transaction is not released because after_action does not run (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:20, 1513-1520).
rationale: Unknown id on the live line-item edit path crashes instead of refusing.

title: QA_Platform_live_add_line_item_without_stage_line
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it adds a second line item to the sandbox.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with line_items = [existing line item, a NEW line item (no uuid) of 3 units].
2. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items (2 items) vs GET /trade/{{tradeId}} (still 1 quotable line).
expectedResult: Should be refused on a live event (or routed through a version). Today 200: create_line_items inserts a new EventGroupLineItem with the event's status 'active' (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:110-148) but no TradeProduct is created on the live RFQ, so vendors cannot quote the new line and awarding sees a line nobody bid on.
rationale: Adding scope to a live event silently, with no vendor notice and no stage line.

title: QA_Platform_live_title_rides_along_with_config
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with a new title and description plus config {show_reference_id: false}.
expectedResult: Today 200 and the title/description change on the live event: a non-empty config sends the request into execute (app/controllers/concerns/event_group_controller_helper.rb:33), which assigns title, description and merges config with no state check (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:47-54). The same title alone is a silent no-op (EDGE-CRT-020), so whether a live rename happens depends on an unrelated key being present. No remark, no notification.
rationale: Live renames are allowed or ignored by accident, not by rule.

title: QA_Platform_live_event_terms_replaced_silently
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it replaces the sandbox event's terms.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with config {show_reference_id: false} and terms_and_conditions {clauses: [one new clause], attachments: []}.
2. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}: terms_and_conditions shows only the new clause.
expectedResult: Should require an amendment (or at least notify invited vendors). Today 200: execute replaces the event-level terms with TermsAndConditions.new(...) on the live event (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:80-82); no remark, no email, no push, and vendors' earlier T&C acceptances are not reset.
rationale: Vendors are held to terms they never saw.

title: QA_Platform_live_event_terms_unknown_key_raises_500
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}} with config {show_reference_id: false} and terms_and_conditions carrying an extra key.
expectedResult: Must be 422. On a LIVE event the terms are built only in execute: TermsAndConditions.new(**hash.symbolize_keys) (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:80-81) raises ArgumentError for the unknown keyword (app/poro_classes/terms_and_conditions.rb:34) → 500. (EDGE-PUB-021 sends the same key with status active + draft stage ids, which on a live event takes the publish-new-stage branch and never builds the terms — so that case cannot reach this line.)
rationale: Reaches the T&C constructor through the path a live event actually uses.

title: QA_Platform_live_config_flips_event_to_boq
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it changes how the sandbox treats line-item edits.
expectedResult: Should be refused (event type is fixed at publish). Today 200: config is merged key-by-key with no allow-list except four scheduling keys (app/services/event_groups/update_service.rb:50-54); boq_based_rfx? then reads true (app/models/event_group.rb:937), and the next line-item edit deletes every line item not in the request (update_service.rb:164-166).
rationale: A free-form config merge lets a live event change type mid-bidding.

title: QA_Platform_live_stage_terms_replaced_push_only
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it replaces the stage's terms.
steps: 1. PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}} with terms_and_conditions [one new plain-text clause].
2. GET /trade/{{tradeId}}: the clause is there; tnc_popup_accepted for vendors is unchanged.
expectedResult: Today 200 (no bids yet, so the "bids received and closed" guard at app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:715-717 does not fire): PersistedArrayBuilder keeps the string clause (app/services/terms_and_conditions/persisted_array_builder.rb:10), send_notification_on_trade_update queues only a push 'update_trade_notification' (trade_controller.rb:722; app/models/trade_request.rb:2423-2428). No email, no remark, and misc.tnc_popup_acceptances is not cleared (trade_request.rb:3048-3063), so a vendor who accepted the old terms is shown as having accepted the new ones.
rationale: Terms change on a live stage without re-acceptance.

title: QA_Platform_live_stage_terms_cleared
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Run it last: it removes the stage's terms.
expectedResult: Today 200: [] is not nil, so the terms branch runs and stores an empty list (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:714-722) — every clause, including mandatory ones, disappears from a live stage with only a push notification. Expect at least a remark requirement.
rationale: Empty-list boundary on the live T&C edit.

title: QA_Platform_reschedule_started_stage_258
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. The stage's bid_start_time is in the past (it is live).
steps: 1. PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}} with bid_start_time and bid_end_time far in the future (the reschedule body).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 258 'You cannot re-schedule this event!' — the reschedule branch refuses once bid_start_time < now (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:605-606). Schedules unchanged. (The dashboard offers Reschedule only for upcoming events, eventHeader.jsx:696-704.)
rationale: Moving the start of a running stage would reopen/close bidding under vendors.

title: QA_Platform_end_time_type_unknown_2
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
steps: 1. PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}} with end_time_type "QA_Platform_bogus" and end_time far in the future.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — end_time_type must be request_for_best_price or request_for_cost_break_down (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:442-443; app/models/trade_schedule.rb:69). time_extension_blocked? runs first but is false with no proposals (trade_controller.rb:438-440).
rationale: Invalid enum on the live end-time edit.

title: QA_Platform_delivery_schedule_unknown_id_raises_500
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Delivery schedule id 999999999 does not exist.
steps: 1. PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}} with delivery_schedules [{id: 999999999, delivery_by: far future}] and nothing else.
expectedResult: Must be 422. The non-reschedule path looks the schedule up with an UNSCOPED DeliverySchedule.where(id: ...).last and assigns to it with no nil check (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:759-765) → NoMethodError → 500. (The reschedule path at line 625-627 scopes to the stage and answers code 15.)
rationale: Unknown id crashes; the same unscoped lookup is a cross-tenant write when the id exists (see API-XDAMD-052).

title: QA_Platform_live_stage_rename_no_remark
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: Today 200: the title branch runs for any non-draft stage and returns early (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:504-509; trade_controller_helper.rb:1408-1428). For a sheet stage with one product the description is overwritten with the delivery location name; for a non-sheet single-product stage the title is silently replaced by the product name. No remark, no notification.
rationale: Baseline for the closed-stage rename (EDGE-DAMD-053).

title: QA_Platform_rename_closed_awarded_stage_allowed
preconditions: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's own pricing stage: bid window closed, one submitted bid from the QA vendor, an award proposal submitted. rfx_project_enabled is OFF (when ON the stage answers 769 first because a proposal is requested/selected). The run did not issue a version of the journey's event (if it did, every write answers 101 first).
expectedResult: Should be refused (a closed stage with a submitted award is a record). Today 200: the title branch sits BEFORE the status allow-list (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:504-509 vs 590-594), so a closed, bid-on, awarded stage can be renamed. Answers 769 instead when rfx_project_enabled is ON, 101 if the journey's event was versioned.
rationale: Closed events must be immutable; this edit path skips the state check entirely.

title: QA_Platform_terms_on_closed_stage_with_bid_4
preconditions: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's own pricing stage: bid window closed, one submitted bid from the QA vendor, an award proposal submitted. rfx_project_enabled is OFF (when ON the stage answers 769 first because a proposal is requested/selected). The run did not issue a version of the journey's event (if it did, every write answers 101 first).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found' — a stage that has bids and whose bid_end_time has passed refuses T&C edits (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:714-717); if the stage status is already 'closed' the status allow-list answers the same code 4 earlier (line 590-594). Alternatives: 769 (rfx_project_enabled ON), 101 (event versioned).
rationale: Terms must not change after vendors have bid and the window has closed.

title: QA_Platform_configurations_on_closed_stage_with_bid_4
preconditions: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's own pricing stage: bid window closed, one submitted bid from the QA vendor, an award proposal submitted. rfx_project_enabled is OFF (when ON the stage answers 769 first because a proposal is requested/selected). The run did not issue a version of the journey's event (if it did, every write answers 101 first).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found' — configurations edits are refused once bids exist and the window closed (app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:723-726). Same alternatives as EDGE-DAMD-054.
rationale: Stage configuration is frozen after close.

title: QA_Platform_line_edit_on_closed_stage_4
preconditions: {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the journey's own pricing stage: bid window closed, one submitted bid from the QA vendor, an award proposal submitted. rfx_project_enabled is OFF (when ON the stage answers 769 first because a proposal is requested/selected). The run did not issue a version of the journey's event (if it did, every write answers 101 first).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 4 'Request not found' — set_product_details_after_edit refuses any line edit on a non-BOQ stage whose bid_end_time has passed (app/controllers/concerns/trade_controller_helper.rb:329-333, called from app/controllers/api/trade_controller.rb:711-713). The id 999999999 matches no line, so nothing could change even if the guard regressed.
rationale: Quantities, specs and price caps of a closed stage must not change under the bids already received.

title: QA_Platform_update_widgets_as_buyer_455
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. The run's buyer is not a Procol employee (users.company_id is not procol_employee_company_id). The sandbox RFQ has widgets.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 455 (You are not authorized to perform this action) — update_widgets? is Procol-employee only (app/policies/trade_request_policy.rb:208-210) and authorize runs inside validate_widget_update_params before the operations are read (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1635-1647). If the stage had no widgets the answer would be 891 first (line 1640). Even past the policy, the bogus operation is refused by WidgetUpdateService (VALID_OPERATIONS).
rationale: Rewriting the columns vendors quote against is a support-only action.

title: QA_Platform_buyer_cannot_accept_vendor_tnc_101
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. The run's buyer user is not also mapped as a vendor of PROCOL DEMO.
steps: 1. PATCH /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/accept_auction_tnc with an empty body, as the buyer.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 101 'You are not allowed to perform this action' — the policy lets the owning company through (app/policies/trade_request_policy.rb:68-72), but no technical response of the buyer and no audience company the buyer can act for is found, so company_id is blank (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:903-913). misc.tnc_popup_acceptances unchanged.
rationale: A buyer must not be able to record a vendor's acceptance of terms.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "accept_auction_tnc"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_add_stage_referring_rfq_2001
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Needs the company setting is_add_new_stage_allowed ON (when OFF the answer is 1127 first).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2001 'New stage cannot be added unless the referring stage is an RFP' — validate_referring_trade_is_rfp (app/services/add_new_stage/validate_service.rb:37-43). No new stage. (The rfq? branch of CreateService, app/services/add_new_stage/create_service.rb:18-19, is therefore unreachable.)
rationale: Only an RFP-only live event can grow an RFQ stage.
notRunnable: needs the company setting "add a new stage to a live event" (is_add_new_stage_allowed) switched ON. It is OFF on PROCOL DEMO — verified live 2026-10-03, every try answered 1127 "Adding a new stage to a live event is not enabled for this company" — and the runner cannot read this setting (it is not in the dashboard configuration), so here the rule behind it can never be reached. Run it on a client with the setting on.

title: QA_Platform_add_stage_without_event_533
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 533 'Project does not exist.' — EventGroup.active.find_by(id: nil, company_id: workspace) is nil (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1123-1124). Independent of is_add_new_stage_allowed.
rationale: Missing parent event id.

title: QA_Platform_add_stage_cross_event_2000
preconditions: is_add_new_stage_allowed is ON (else 1127). {{pricingTradeUuid}} is the JOURNEY's stage; {{eventGroupUuid}} is the SANDBOX event — two different events of the same company.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2000 'Trade request and event group are not linked' — validate_trade_request_event_group_link (app/services/add_new_stage/validate_service.rb:29-35). Neither event changes.
rationale: Grafting a stage of one event onto another event.
notRunnable: needs the company setting "add a new stage to a live event" (is_add_new_stage_allowed) switched ON. It is OFF on PROCOL DEMO — verified live 2026-10-03, every try answered 1127 "Adding a new stage to a live event is not enabled for this company" — and the runner cannot read this setting (it is not in the dashboard configuration), so here the rule behind it can never be reached. Run it on a client with the setting on.

title: QA_Platform_add_stage_to_rfp_rfq_event_1129
preconditions: rfp_rfq run: the sandbox has an RFP stage {{rfpTradeId}} and an RFQ stage. is_add_new_stage_allowed is ON (else 1127).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 1129 'New stage cannot be added to an RFP and RFQ event' (app/services/add_new_stage/validate_service.rb:54-59).
rationale: The event already has both stage types.
notRunnable: needs the company setting "add a new stage to a live event" (is_add_new_stage_allowed) switched ON. It is OFF on PROCOL DEMO — verified live 2026-10-03, every try answered 1127 "Adding a new stage to a live event is not enabled for this company" — and the runner cannot read this setting (it is not in the dashboard configuration), so here the rule behind it can never be reached. Run it on a client with the setting on.

title: QA_Platform_add_stage_unknown_stage_95
preconditions: Authenticated buyer; Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to a stage id that does not exist.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 95 'Trade Request not found' — the stage lookup is scoped to the caller's workspace and runs before the policy (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1120-1121).
rationale: Unknown referring stage; the reply names the missing stage, which is the anticipated outcome here.

title: QA_Platform_read_version_fields_of_unversioned_event
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. Nothing has versioned the sandbox yet.
steps: 2. Check is_latest_version, item_versions, is_amendment_draft, amendment_remarks and config.can_create_new_version.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 with is_latest_version true (app/serializers/event_group/show_serializer.rb:282-284), item_versions [] (all_versions returns [] when no version chain exists, app/models/versioning/methods.rb:37-42), is_amendment_draft null (non-draft, methods.rb:97-98), amendment_remarks.remarks null (methods.rb:114-123) and config.can_create_new_version true only when is_event_versioning_enabled is on and the caller shares a team with the owner or is super admin (app/models/event_group.rb:1091-1107).
rationale: The read-back oracle every amendment case compares against.

title: QA_Platform_read_line_items_of_live_event
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 listing the one active line item and its quantity. Run after EDGE-DAMD-034/038 (they run last) this read shows the live edits that the stage's trade products do not carry.
rationale: Read-back oracle for the live line-item edits.

title: QA_Platform_read_stage_terms_and_acceptance
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 200. is_tnc_popup_enabled follows the company's tnc_popup config for rfq (app/models/trade_request.rb:3035-3042); tnc_popup_accepted reads misc.tnc_popup_acceptances for the caller's companies (trade_request.rb:3060-3063; app/serializers/trade_serializer.rb:59-69).
rationale: Read-back oracle for the T&C amendment cases.

title: QA_Platform_get_lots_unknown_event_raises_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== decodes to an event id that does not exist.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2. get_lots calls `event_group.latest?` BEFORE its blank check (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:894-896), so a missing event is nil.latest? → NoMethodError → 500.
rationale: The version guard was inserted above the not-found guard.

title: QA_Platform_get_lots_without_stage_2
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters' — the event is live and latest, the read policy passes, and no RFQ stage id was given (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:893-899).
rationale: Positive control for EDGE-DAMD-069: same endpoint, existing event, readable refusal.

title: QA_Platform_save_draft_lots_unknown_event_raises_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw== is not an event; nothing can be written.
steps: 1. PATCH /event_groups/Z2dnWmdaUWtnZw==/save_draft_lots with a minimal lots hash.
expectedResult: Must be 422. save_draft_lots checks `!event_group.latest?` before `event_group.blank?` (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:925-929) → nil.latest? → 500.
rationale: Same guard-order defect on a write endpoint.

title: QA_Platform_reset_smart_lots_unknown_event_raises_500
preconditions: Authenticated buyer. Both ids decode to records that do not exist; nothing can be written.
expectedResult: Must be 422 code 2. Both ids are present so the blank check passes, then EventGroup.active.find_by(...) is nil and `!event_group.latest?` runs before the nil check (app/controllers/api/event_groups_controller.rb:908-916) → 500.
rationale: Third endpoint with the latest?-before-nil ordering.

title: QA_Platform_trade_history_buyer_455
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals. The run's buyer is not a Procol employee (users.company_id is not procol_employee_company_id).
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 455 'You are not authorized to perform this action' — the stage is found in the buyer's workspace and validate_event passes, then trade_history? allows Procol employees only (app/controllers/api/v1/trade_controller.rb:1412-1418; app/policies/trade_request_policy.rb:204-206).
rationale: The bid-history export is support-only; a buyer-facing audit of changes is not available here.
notRunnable: the web console app is not enabled for this action (config/app_auth_config.yml → client_admin_dashboard has no "trade_history"), so the buyer's console session gets 401 "This app is not authorized to use this API" — and every 401 marks that session logged out (json_helpers.rb check_session_validity), which would end the run for every case after it. It needs the app this endpoint is enabled for (the vendor/mobile client).

title: QA_Platform_versions_log_of_own_stage

steps: 2. Read the change list (column, [old, new]) and the user who made each change.

title: QA_Platform_versions_log_unbounded_count
preconditions: The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single RFQ stage {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids, no proposals.
expectedResult: HTTP 200 today with limit(1000000) — there is no upper bound on count (app/controllers/api/versions_log_controller.rb:8, 14). A page cap would be expected; at minimum the read must not time out into a 5xx.
rationale: Unbounded page size on an audit table that grows with every edit.
